summary: R4 complete: the mod's stealth-touching layer as of the current working tree. All script aggro now flows through two chokepoints — the aihandler::attackPlayer funnel (aihandler.scr:1038, used by disguiseHandler, sentientIsSeen/Heard, and all seven anim/disguise_*.scr coop preambles) and the cvar-free engine-parity gate coop_stealthBlocksAggro (aihandler.scr:1184, bug-1639: per-target it defers to the ENGINE is_disguised flag; no-target form blocks only while every live player is engine-disguised, always open once level.alarm=1 or on non-disguise maps). The gate is consulted by exactly four sources: replica clones (attackplayer gated, forceactivate deliberately NOT), aisquad go-loud + search (full stand-down incl. forceactivate), and morale berserk (full stand-down). Everything else that can hand an actor a target is raw and protected only by circumstance: setEnemyAttackStates' restore (fires only if actors were in attack/pain during a disguise-grant window), officer.scr's ~30 wave sites (protected solely by the per-map policy — m2l2a/e1l4/m1l3c/m4l0/m6l1c/m6l3c are "deferred" = nothing spawns until level.alarm; m1l2a is deliberately "combat"), wounded.scr re-engages (pain-gated), aimaneuver.scr (acts on ANY actor with enemy!=NULL — and the engine deliberately retains a disguised player as a zero-threat enemy, so it can runto+forceactivate a tracking guard during stealth), the m2l2a map's own retail bust sites, and global/alarm_system.scr's flow (whose $ai_alarm alarmthread hook now carries the today-guard blocking a disguised-contact alarm trip pre-alarm; the backup spawns never attackplayer at all — they runtoClosest and rely on native detection). Cover-break is centralized: takeAllDisguises (itemhandler.scr:1138, called from alarm master :704, items.scr, e1l4) clears engine has_disguise in a changeGameType-0 window and chains coop_armOnBlown; the experimental unarmed-start layer is dormant (coop_stealthStart/coop_stealthNoAggro both forced 0), and the two m2l2a "lift the guard" setcvar sites are now dead wiring because the rewired gates no longer read that cvar. Live-by-default systems that WILL touch m2l2a actors pre-alarm: coop_aiDynamic=1 (personality rolls incl. 12% prone-pose w/ attackentity exit), coop_aiScale unset=ON (scene-actor cloning at 2+ players), coop_aiSquad=1, coop_moraleEnable=1, aimaneuver.
key_facts: FUNNEL: coop_mod/aihandler.scr::attackPlayer (:1038-1105) = say-bark + enablePain=1 + flags[coop_isAttacking]=1 + RAW attackplayer + favoriteenemy. Callers: disguiseHandler :1024, sentientIsHeard :1136/:1142, sentientIsSeen :1167, anim/disguise_{accept,deny,enemy,halt,wait,salute}.scr coop preambles (all pass self.enemy), maps/e1l2/Artillery.scr:87. Its broad guard (:1076) requires coop_stealthNoAggro!=0 AND coop_stealthFunnelGuard==1 — autoexec.cfg:1176 seeds coop_stealthNoAggro 0, so the funnel guard is DEAD in the current config (verified 08-09 10:38 the three source gates alone held attackers at 0/25).

GATE: coop_stealthBlocksAggro (aihandler.scr:1184-1223) is now CVAR-FREE (bug-1639 engine parity). Per-target: blocks iff target.is_disguised==1 && !level.alarm && level.coop_enableDisguises. No-target: blocks only while EVERY live player is engine-disguised. Consulted by exactly 4 sites: coop_spawnReplica aihandler.scr:274 (gates attackplayer ONLY — forceactivate ALWAYS runs, gating it left clones inert), aisquad.scr:114 (full stand-down: no attackplayer/favoriteenemy/forceactivate/enablePain, last-known stamped only AFTER the gate) and :139 (search pass kill-switch), morale.scr:71 (berserk full stand-down).

RAW UNGATED aggro sites in coop_mod: setEnemyAttackStates (aihandler.scr:1285) raw attackplayer restore on any actor that was in attack/pain thinkstate when giveDisguise/giveDisguiseToAll ran (resetEnemyThinkstates :1260 collects them); officer.scr ~30 attackplayer/forceactivate sites (officer spawn :537, bodyguards :676/:687, medkit-retreat re-engage :1040/:1048/:1090, wave hunt :1369, prone-exit :1794+attackentity :1808, elite/infantry :1979/:2094, MG42 team :2165 (+type_disguise machinegunner :2161), sniper :2254/:2283, grenadiers :2400, AT team :2861/:2879, dogs :3057/:3076/:3112/:3140); wounded.scr tactical-retreat re-engage :219 and limp-fail rejoin :337 (both pain-path); aimaneuver.scr :149-150 runto+forceactivate; holdout.scr :430/:578 (coop_holdout defaults 0 = inert); replace.scr::attackplayer :2780 (client-0-safe shim; sets favoriteenemy when no client 0; exposed as game.attackplayer via variables.scr:33).

OFFICER POLICY is the only stealth protection for the wave layer (officer.scr::coop_officer_policy :30): m2l2a/e1l4/m1l3c/m4l0/m6l1c/m6l3c = 'deferred' — coop_officer_init (:131, threaded from main.scr:165) blocks in coop_officer_wait_goloud (:118) polling level.alarm/alarmSounded/alarmactive for up to 600s before ANY officer/wave entity exists. m1l2a is deliberately 'combat' (spawns post-intro on a disguise map, anchor kept >1000u from the checkpoint). Officer spawn itself does raw attackplayer+forceactivate (:537-541).

ALARM FLOW (global/alarm_system.scr): engine calls self.alarmthread=ai_alarm_alerted (set in ai_alarm_setup :337, which also sets type_attack="alarm") on $ai_alarm actors. TODAY guard (:393-406): pre-alarm on a disguise-enabled map, a trip whose enemy is an engine-disguised player (or no enemy while nobody is undisguised) is dropped (engine keeps a disguised player as a ZERO-THREAT enemy per actorenemy.cpp:446, which is why routine contacts used to ring it). Then: alerted stack -> ai_gofor_alarm (:476) picks a live alerted guy still in attack thinkstate who can see a player -> unholster + disable_ai + runto switch node + turnto (anims/moves on a map actor) -> douse switch -> alarm_switch_thread (:669) -> $waittrigger_alarm_master -> alarm_system_master (:688): level.alarm=1, takeAllDisguises, switch anim turnon, backup spawning + sounds. Master is a TOGGLE — a second trigger sets level.alarm=0 (:716-730) but disguises stay gone. Backup dudes NEVER attackplayer: forceactivate + replace::runtoClosest only (:894-902). Other ring paths: player touching/using $alarm_switch_trigger; m2l2a label alarmall (:349, BSP-trigger driven, douse with closest player as activator).

DISGUISE STATE: giveDisguise/giveDisguiseToAll (itemhandler.scr:937/:991) set engine has_disguise inside changeGameType-0 windows, bracketed by resetEnemyThinkstates/setEnemyAttackStates + deactivate/activatePlayerWeapon; retry loop on failure; success starts disguiseHandler. takeAllDisguises (:1138) = the single 'gone for good' chokepoint (alarm master :704, global/items.scr uniform-take ~:477, e1l4 ship scripts) — clears has/is flags in a 0-window then chains coop_armOnBlown (:1394: clears coop_startUnarmed/coop_noWeapon/coop_forcePapersEquip, re-issues loadouts, displaces papers). takeDisguise (:2449) per-player equivalent. setIsDisguised (:2439) writes ONLY the mod flag coop_isDisguised; the engine flag is getter-only (is_disguised) and is maintained per-frame by the engine since bug-1638 (player.cpp:5488 g_coopDisgParity default 1; :5511 attack-veto requires GetCurrentThreat()>0 — both verified in tree).

WEAPONSTATE (weaponstate.scr, from global/mike_torso state transitions): RAISE_WEAPON -> setIsDisguised(player, awep==NULL || classname!="Weapon") — the 08-09 fix: a held INVENTORY ITEM (papers) keeps the disguise, mirroring engine player.cpp:5480; PUTAWAY_MAIN -> setIsDisguised true; ATTACK (fired) while disguised -> broadcastSound(player,"explosion",1024) = ai_event, an ENGINE-level noise stimulus that bypasses every script gate, + sentientIsHeard 1s later; silenced exemptions: silencedpistol.tik, it_w_carcano.tik.

PAPERS: items.scr pickups (papers_level1/2 :199/:218) -> givePapersFlagToAll (:2530) -> givePapersFlag -> coop_papersAnytime (:1207, primaryfire-while-unarmed presents papers any time, one guarded instance/player); engine disguise think runs anim/disguise_papers.scr -> enableClickablePapers (:2546, interrogation-window click-to-show); disguise_accept.scr -> coop_paperPassAll (:1176): sets guard.coop_paperPass, type_disguise "none" (the bug-1631 freeze arm: think-swap 50ms into ACCEPT tears down the sentry think mid-anim), clears clickable flag squad-wide; forcePapersInHand (main.scr:1015) under level.coop_forcePapersEquip; managePlayerInventory's stealth respawn papers re-give + disguise grant sits ABOVE the coop_noWeapon early-exit (itemhandler.scr:719-742); itemGetAll (main.scr:906) re-gives items + forces papers in hand each spawn.

DORMANT STEALTH-START LAYER (coop_stealthStart, forced 0 in autoexec.cfg:1175 + coop_defaults.cfg:207): m2l2a.scr:38-42 would set coop_noWeapon/coop_startUnarmed/coop_forcePapersEquip at map load; coop_stealthStripWeapons (itemhandler.scr:1240, 4-pass class drain + forced setIsDisguised + starts watchdog) called at uniform pickup (m2l2a.scr:833); coop_stealthHoldDisguise (:1303) 2Hz mod-flag re-assert + STEALTHWATCH/STEALTHWHO census (coop_aggroDebug-gated); coop_stealthArmOnHurt (:1375) has ZERO callers — dead code superseded by m2l2a::coop_blownOnDamage (:571, polls player HP drops with a german-in-attack-within-1600u filter).

M2L2A raw map-side aggro/anim sites (all retail-bust semantics): waitForEnemy :914 attackplayer+type_disguise none (loops on canseeUndisguisedPlayers = engine-flag, bug-1609 waitthread fix); cardplayersdeath :270 ($suckyfatty attackplayer when a card player dies); sentry2thing :307; unholsterweapon :346; sentry1alarm :1106 (goatsbutt); ohnothenaxos1 :615-639 (disable_ai + scientist_detachclipboard anims + unholster + attackplayer x3); coop_naxosCaught :488 and coop_blownOnDamage :592 both still `setcvar coop_stealthNoAggro 0` — NOW DEAD WIRING (the rewired gates never read it); their effective action is coop_armOnBlown. Scientists/watchers are type_disguise "none" (:210-212,:454,:808-809,:1001-1002); the retail salute-flip for the norway pair is SP-only now (:863-864, coop keeps "none" because saluters trapped at the card table — PassesTransitionConditions_Disguise beats walkto). Card-table scene = suckyfatty/scientists in maps/m2l2a.scr (standattable :693/:1089), NOT global/cardgame.scr (its type_disguise sets :275/:365 are behind 'level waittill spawn' which never fires in coop).

CONTAGION PATHS: actorHandler death-witness (aihandler.scr:148-152): killing a german in view funnels sentientIsSeen(corpse, killer, 360) — gated level.coop_enableDisguises; disguiseHandler 1s loop (:997-1034): attack-state contagion (:1014-1016, sentientIsSeen(enemy, enemy.enemy)) + undisguised-player spotting (:1019-1028 — NOTE tests the MOD flag !coop_isDisguised, not engine is_disguised); the loop terminates permanently once level.alarm=1.

changeGameType (main.scr:1647): sets the g_gametype CVAR only; single instance via level.coop_changeGameTypeThread (always waitthread); no-op when level.gametype==0 or coop_preventGameTypeChanges (map load/transition — missioncomplete.scr:52, maptest.scr:186, lobby.scr:683 kill the thread). Complete caller set: itemhandler weapon/item gives (:247,:1693/:1718,:1759,:1977,:2650), disguise grant/take (:965,:1010,:1148,:2455), main.scr::coop_reissueMissionItems (:956/:973), dbno.scr:731/:779 + medkit.scr:379/:428 revive re-gives, player.scr fov (:744) + set3rdPerson (:1549), maps/e1l4/Intro.scr:418-424 (direct 0-window has_disguise grant — the fallback recipe). Each was a flag-freeze window pre-bug-1638; post-parity they only matter as g_gametype churn + the single-instance serialization.

LIVE-BY-DEFAULT config (autoexec.cfg + coop_defaults.cfg): coop_aiDynamic 1 (:580 — personality rolls on every german incl. m2l2a scene actors, + aimaneuver + engine juke timers), coop_aiSquad 1 (:583), coop_moraleEnable 1 (:591), coop_retreatEnable 1 (:593), coop_aiVoice 1; coop_aiScale UNSEEDED = ON (aihandler gate only ends on =="0") so 2+ players clone germans; coop_aiSearch/coop_aiAggrMove/coop_aggroDebug/coop_stealthFunnelGuard unseeded ("") = all off; coop_stealthStart 0 / coop_stealthNoAggro 0 (HZM-baseline revert block :1171-1176).
constraints_for_designers: attackplayer is a ONE-WAY LATCH: Actor::ForceAttackPlayer sets m_bForceAttackPlayer, cleared only in the Actor ctor; EnemyIsDisguised() then returns false forever for that actor. NEVER fire attackplayer (raw or via the funnel) at a player the engine currently counts disguised. attackentity is the latch-free alternative (bug-1479 pattern, officer.scr:1806-1809) and returns silently on bad targets; it still sets a real enemy, so even it should be avoided pre-alarm.

forceactivate yanks an actor out of scripted animations (measured: two card players stood up from the table). Stealth stand-downs must suppress forceactivate too (aisquad/morale do) — with ONE exception: a freshly spawned replica must ALWAYS forceactivate or it is born inert ('animations blocked'); only its targeting goes behind the gate (aihandler.scr:267-278).

The stealth gates are engine-parity and cvar-free: do NOT reintroduce a cvar window. Per-target truth = target.is_disguised; no-target calls must judge the room via anyPlayerNotDisguised (itemhandler.scr:1059). A blocked attempt must leave NO trace — stamping coop_lastKnown (or any search hint) before the gate leaks 'suspicion' sweeps that break scripted scenes (aisquad.scr:119-122 comment).

enemy != NULL does NOT mean combat: the engine deliberately RETAINS a disguised player as a zero-threat enemy (actorenemy.cpp:446) so papers checks can track you. Any logic keyed on .enemy (aimaneuver candidacy, aisquad SB1 cluster-threat + last-known stamping at :86, morale 'engaged' test) treats a tracking guard as engaged. New systems must additionally consult is_disguised (and ideally threat) before touching such actors.

type_disguise swap mid-disguise-think = the bug-1631 freeze: firing type_disguise "none" while the guard is inside his ACCEPT think tears down the running anim thread and the none-think has no functions — frozen forever. Any retirement of a papers guard (coop_paperPassAll) must be deferred until his disguise anim script exits.

setEnemyAttackStates' restore is raw attackplayer applied to every actor flagged during a disguise-grant window (anyEnemiesInAttackState -> resetEnemyThinkstates). A zero-threat limbo actor parked in attack thinkstate at grant time gets permanently latched at the exact moment the squad puts uniforms on. Keep pre-grant attacker count at 0, or make the restore per-target disguise-aware, before relying on giveDisguiseToAll mid-map.

Two disguise flags exist and CAN disagree: mod coop_isDisguised (script-writable, weaponstate-transition-driven, papers-in-hand keeps it) vs engine is_disguised (getter-only, per-frame parity since bug-1638). aihandler's canseeUndisguisedPlayers + all gates read the ENGINE flag; disguiseHandler's spotting test (:1021) still reads the MOD flag. Any new detection code must use the engine flag; any code that must WRITE engine state needs a changeGameType-0 window (has_disguise) — is_disguised itself cannot be written from script at all.

Firing a loud weapon while disguised is DESIGNED to leak: ai_event('explosion', r1024) is an engine stimulus no script gate sees. Silence list is exactly silencedpistol.tik + it_w_carcano.tik (weaponstate.scr:80-84). Do not expect script gates to hold if the player shoots.

Officer/wave layer has NO stealth gates of its own — the per-map policy table (officer.scr::coop_officer_policy) is the only protection. Any NEW disguise/stealth map MUST be added to the 'deferred' list or the boss + waves spawn latched-hostile pre-alarm. Waves also scale/exempt via flags (coop_waveActor, coop_actorStopPainHandler) — keep those on custom spawns.

The alarm master is a TOGGLE: re-triggering a switch sets level.alarm=0, but takeAllDisguises already ran and giveDisguiseToAll refuses while enableDisguises is false — post-off state is 'no alarm, no disguises, gates open'. Do not assume alarm-off restores stealth.

Alarm backup reinforcements deliberately never attackplayer (forceactivate + runtoClosest, native detection does the rest) — this is the proven shape for spawning reinforcements that still respect disguise; copy it instead of attackplayer for anything that may spawn while a player is disguised.

changeGameType: waitthread only, one instance globally, silently no-ops during map load/transition (coop_preventGameTypeChanges) — a disguise grant that can race a transition must tolerate the no-op or use the e1l4 Intro direct-window recipe. Nesting gives inside an existing 0-window uses the noWrap parameter (coop_giveSidearmPick :1759).

m2l2a's `setcvar coop_stealthNoAggro 0` lifts (:493, :592) are dead wiring after bug-1639 — the effective cover-break actions are coop_armOnBlown, players drawing weapons (parity flips is_disguised same-frame), and level.alarm. Remove or repurpose them rather than building on them.

Language traps that bit this exact layer: entity-waitthread with ONE argument is the proven form (two-arg entity-thread broke blueprints); `thread label` in a condition evaluates the HANDLE not the return (bug-1609 — use waitthread); NIL and NULL both mean 'no weapon in hand' (bug-1603); morlang has no [] empty-array literal; a continuation line starting with a binary operator parse-kills the whole file; $player is 1-indexed.
mechanisms: AGGRO GRAPH (complete): [A] Engine-native: threat system attacks undisguised players reversibly (actorenemy.cpp:164) — untouched by scripts; disguise think dispatches anim/disguise_*.scr per type_disguise. [B] Funnel: {disguiseHandler spotting/contagion, sentientIsSeen, sentientIsHeard, all 7 disguise anim preambles, e1l2 Artillery} -> aihandler::attackPlayer -> raw attackplayer+favoriteenemy (funnel guard present but dead in config). [C] Gated sources: replica birth / aisquad SB2 go-loud / aisquad SS1 search / morale berserk -> coop_stealthBlocksAggro (engine-parity) -> raw attackplayer(+favoriteenemy+forceactivate) or full stand-down. [D] Raw circumstantial: setEnemyAttackStates restore (disguise-grant windows), wounded re-engages (pain), officer waves (policy-timed), aimaneuver (enemy!=NULL), holdout (cvar-off), map/gag scripts (m2l2a bust labels, t1l3, e1l1, e3l4...), global helpers (alarmer.scr, SurpriseAttack, chainspawner, turret/mg42 crews, welder/wrenching, autotank, vehicles_thinkers, enable_ai-driven ai.scr:589).

NOISE/SIGHT PROPAGATION: weaponstate ATTACK (loud, disguised) -> ai_event explosion r1024 (engine) + sentientIsHeard(player) after 1s; sentientIsHeard replicates engine hearing (PVS half-range guaranteed, full-range awareness% roll); sentientIsSeen replicates sight (PVS + cansee(fov,sight)); actor death with player killer -> sentientIsSeen(corpse, killer, 360) = witnesses aggro; disguiseHandler loops every 1s until alarm: attackers infect line-of-sight neighbors, and any actor seeing a weapon-drawn (mod-flag-undisguised) player is funneled + double-propagated.

ALARM RING: engine alert on $ai_alarm actor -> ai_alarm_alerted (today-guard drops disguised contacts pre-alarm) -> alerted stack -> gofor loop (only live actors still in attack thinkstate that can see a player; disable_ai/runto to switch node; abandons if player closer) -> douse switch -> master -> level.alarm=1 + takeAllDisguises (-> coop_armOnBlown) + switch anims + backup spawner cycle (zone-scoped, cap ai_alarm_backup_max, forceactivate+runtoClosest, remove when far+unseen) + loop sounds. Player can also douse/touch the switch, and m2l2a's alarmall label does it scripted.

DISGUISE LIFECYCLE (m2l2a route): map load sets coop_enableDisguises (uniform pickup at likeynorway -> items.scr add_item uniform+papers_level1 -> giveUniformToAll + giveDisguiseToAll [0-window engine has_disguise, thinkstate bracket] -> disguiseHandler starts; papers pickups -> givePapersFlagToAll -> per-player papersAnytime). Per-frame: engine parity recomputes is_disguised (holster/inventory-item = disguised, weapon drawn = blown); weaponstate transitions mirror the mod flag. Interrogation: engine disguise think -> disguise_papers (enableClickablePapers) -> accept (coop_paperPassAll retires guard via type_disguise none - freeze risk) / deny / enemy (attackPlayer funnel). Cover-break chokepoint: takeAllDisguises -> coop_armOnBlown (arm players, clear stealth flags, displace papers).

SCENE-INTERFERENCE (anim-on-map-actor) inventory: engine disguise think anims (salute/papers/appease/reject/alert + lookat/aimat/unholster); alarm gofor movement; backup-dude runto; aimaneuver runto+forceactivate (enemy!=NULL, flank/cover roles, 4s cadence); aisquad search runto (off: coop_aiSearch unseeded); prone-shooter anim_scripted pose + stand-up (12% personality roll, coop_aiDynamic=1) ending in attackentity(closest player); canteen sip upperanim (hurt troopers); wounded/morale retreat movers (pain/kill-gated); replica clones (forceactivate always, personality applied); m2l2a scripted scenes (card table standattable, scientists clipboard anims, welders, salute swaps SP-only).
open_questions: coop_apply_personality under coop_aiDynamic=1 runs on EVERY german at spawn including m2l2a scene actors: a 12% prone roll anim_scripted-poses the actor (card players/scientists?) and its stand-up exit fires attackentity at the closest player pre-alarm (no stealth gate, no latch). The weapongroup whitelist (unarmed -> falls back to cover role) may be saving seated/unarmed scene actors — unmeasured. Needs a census run (coop_aiBehav 1 + PRONEDBG lines) on m2l2a before trusting the scene.

Replica cloning is ON by default (coop_aiScale unseeded; only =="0" disables) and its exemptions (VIP armor, turret, waveActor, stopPainHandler) do NOT cover ordinary scene germans — with 2+ players m2l2a's card players/scientists/checkpoint guards can be duplicated mid-scene (clone gated from targeting but forceactivated + personality-rolled). Scene coherence during the stealth window is unassessed.

aimaneuver.scr has no stealth gate and acts on enemy!=NULL: a flank/cover-role guard TRACKING a disguised player (zero-threat retained enemy) can be issued runto+forceactivate mid-interrogation/salute. Not directly observed in the 08-09 logs (MANEUVER counters exist but weren't correlated with the pre-alarm window); either gate it like aisquad or verify trackers never carry the role flags.

disguiseHandler's spotting test (aihandler.scr:1021) still reads the MOD flag (!flags[coop_isDisguised]) while every other 08-09 site was moved to the ENGINE flag (bug-1639). A mod/engine desync window (forced states, holster races outside the papers rule) funnels attackPlayer with the funnel guard dead-by-config. Should :1021 defer to is_disguised for full parity?

bug-1631 freeze fix direction (defer coop_paperPassAll's type_disguise "none" until the guard's disguise think exits) is recorded but NOT yet implemented — itemhandler.scr:1181 still swaps immediately.

Dead wiring left standing: coop_stealthArmOnHurt (itemhandler.scr:1375, zero callers) and the two m2l2a `setcvar coop_stealthNoAggro 0` lifts — harmless but misleading for the next designer; candidates for cleanup alongside whatever the master plan v2 decides.

morale FALTER path (morale.scr:56-61) forces wounded coop_checkTacticalRetreat whose re-engage ends in RAW attackplayer (wounded.scr:219) with no stealth gate — reachable pre-alarm only in the contrived case where half the german force dies while every player stays disguised (scripted deaths). Worth a one-line per-target gate if the stealth window is to be bulletproof.
